messages:
alice: heads-up: started triage for missing metadata on recent eval-runner uploads. a few q8 bring-ups have manifests without dataset/owner/retention_ttl so GC considered them orphaned and evicted.

ben: ack. any sample ids?

alice: sample trace id 1f3b8d22 from nightly quantize run. i pulled the upload manifest from logs, it looks like this:

alice: ```json\n{\n  \"trace_id\": \"1f3b8d22\",\n  \"uploader\": \"eval-runner-6\",\n  \"started_at\": \"2026-11-12T02:15:03Z\",\n  \"samples\": 128,\n  \"size_bytes\": 612480\n}\n```

maya: absent required enrichment fields: dataset/owner/retention_ttl/manifest_schema. runner is supposed to add them after trace finalization.

rishi: reminds me of the flaky manifest-enrich race we saw earlier where the enrichment job finished after the upload returned 202. GC lists objects immediately and treats missing keys as candidates for deletion.

storage-team: correct. our GC rule currently flags traces missing owner or retention_ttl and puts them into a 7-day eviction queue. these came in under prefix eval-runner/v2/2026-11-12/ so they were eligible.

ben: we have two remediation axes: prevent partial manifests from being visible to GC, or make GC tolerant (consult enrichment-state table / add grace window).

maya: proposal:
- short term: pause GC for prefix eval-runner/v2/* for 72 hours and run backfill that re-enriches recent manifests. add temporary protection field protected_until on backfilled manifests.
- medium term: runner writes manifest as manifest.partial, performs enrichment + HMAC, then atomically moves/renames to manifest.json. add manifest_schema header (e.g., v2.1).
- CI: add integration test that injects artificial delay in enrichment and asserts final manifest contains dataset, owner, retention_ttl within 30s.

leo: +1 for atomic rename. also recommend adding retention_class enum (ephemeral,persistent,regression) so GC rules are simpler.

storage-team: we can pause GC for that prefix and run a dry-run backfill next UTC 02:00. backfill needs idempotency and a mapping of uploader->owner to tag correctly.

rishi: CI action: failing the runner build on schema mismatch seems reasonable. also add nightly replay test that uploads a handful of traces and validates final manifest + GC-safety semantics.

eng-sre: will add an alert that fires if >5% of uploads in 24h are missing mandatory manifest fields.

product/metrics: note that backfill could increase load on storage and ci infra; please estimate impact so we can notify downstream teams.

ben: cost note: expected backfill scan ~30-50GB; maybe some multipart rehydration. storage-team to confirm.

storage-team: confirmed. we'll run subset first and share logs here.

maya: i'll open PR with manifest.partial -> manifest.json rename + HMAC verification and include unit/integration tests. will target EOD Friday for initial patch.

alice: i'll create tickets for the GC pause, backfill job, and the manifest schema doc. also agree on adding protected_until and retention_class.

ci-bot: test-suite "runner-manifest-enrich-sim" queued by maya.

alice: thanks everyone. let's keep this thread updated with backfill results and PR links. if we see any additional evictions, escalate to oncall.
